---
title: "Temperature data reference"
subtitle: Generated from [output_schema.yaml](../../assetsyaml/output_schema.yaml)
---



Temperature data recorded every 8 hours when wet

- #### **session_id** 
 *type:string* 
  Unique ID of the logger deployment session during which this record was made. 

- #### **individ_id** 
 *type:string* 
  Unique ID of individual. 

- #### **date_time** 
 *type:datetime* 
  Date and time of each record in GMT. 

- #### **wet_temp_min** 
 *type:float* 
  Minimum temperature recorded in degrees Celsius (sampled when continuously wet for ≥20 min). 

- #### **wet_temp_max** 
 *type:float* 
  Maximum temperature recorded in degrees Celsius  (sampled when continuously wet for ≥20 min). 

- #### **wet_temp_mean** 
 *type:float* 
  Mean temperature recorded in degrees Celsius (sampled when continuously wet for ≥20 min). 

- #### **num_samples** 
 *type:integer* 
  Number of samples recorded in the last 8 hours
